tech_constraints: Primarily hosted on managed containers in eu-west-1 and us-east-1
Client uses Redwood SDK v0.9.x (reported default timeout 10s)
Average request size currently ~1,800 tokens (system + history + doc snippets)
recommended_quick_configs: Endpoint: use eu-west-1 endpoint for EU traffic (reduce RTT) + fallback to us-east-1 with automatic routing policy
Timeouts: client soft timeout 8s, server call timeout 12s, implement exponential backoff for retries (max 2 retries)
Prompt guidance: keep convo history to last 3 turns, compress long docs to 250-350 token summaries, enforce max_input_tokens 2,000
Streaming: enable streaming responses on chat UI to improve perceived latency for users
Batching/caching: small prefix KV cache for fixed system prompt and frequent user intents
